_comment: Reviewed high/critical dependency advisories, consumed by scripts/audit-ratchet.mjs.
- An advisory NOT listed here fails the Security workflow. New debt is blocked.
- A listed advisory that no longer reproduces ALSO fails, so the list can only
shrink. That is what makes this a ratchet rather than an ignore-list.
- Every entry needs a `reason` stating the real exposure in THIS codebase and,
if the fix is deferred, the concrete blocker. 'Transitive' is not a reason.
State as of 2026-09-25: empty. The backlog that existed when the gate was built
(4 high in server, 1 in frontend, 3 in mobile) was fixed rather than accepted:
fast-uri 3.1.5->3.1.8, and the @tiptap/* tree unified on 3.31.3.
